items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Duke's band was as great as it was because Cootie Williams had a brother here, we went to school together

ctx.x: That was really more influential in a way than Duke was, in a way, wasn't it? AT THAT TIME.

Well, I'm gonna show you how square I was -- I didn't know Duke's band was as great as it was because Cootie Williams had a brother here, we went to school together -- Barney Google (BARNET). He would say, "My brother plays with you; Duke's the greatest band." I would

say, "No, the greatest band was Jimmy Luntzwood." I'm a kid. I didn't know Duke's greatness, then. What I looked at was Jimmy Luntzwood; he had a good show band and I felt him, and you know, it wasn't like that with Duke. Duke was playing so heavy that I didn't know what he was doing. But he was way ahead of his time, and it all come out in the washing before it was over with.

items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did Cootie's brother play anything? [INTERVIEWER] He played trumpet, but he couldn't play -- he played in the school band; he played out the side of his mouth.

ctx.x: I learned ... as I experienced it, I learned.
He played trumpet, but he couldn't play -- he played in the school band; he played out the side of his mouth.
